_comment: The benchmark environment this commit expects (docs/adr/0018): the pin (sha256 of the canonical environment manifest) of the image container/benchmark.Dockerfile builds. A real-world run in any other image gets its own run id (-env<hash>). Update it in the same commit as any change to the Dockerfile, a dependency set or the manifest generator, after rebuilding the image: python -m bench container-run prints the pin.
